Brake! uses Accessibility Services permission to collect information about currently running apps and their usage status in order to enable the \'Session Timer\' feature when you start using designated apps. This permission allows Brake! to identify which app is running on your screen and display a \'Session Timer\' overlay when it\'s one of your pre-set \'Managed Apps\'. The information collected is used exclusively to provide the \'Session Timer\' feature and absolutely no other personal information is collected. Do you agree to activate this feature?
